system.description:
The Sidereal spends eight motes to envelop her mount in a nimbus of faint yellow light for the rest of the scene. No activation roll is required. The enchanted mount may Dash reflexively without requiring the rider's action and without risk of fatigue from Dashing. Also, the animal can gallop through, up or over natural obstacles such as dense forests, crowds, cliffs, open water or even gaping chasms as easily as it can move across flat, open terrain. Unnatural obstacles, such as human-made walls or sorcerous barricades, still impede progress as normal.

Errata: Glory Path does not improve the mount's speed as described in the original text and does not require an activation roll. Instead, it allows the enchanted mount to Dash reflexively and without risk of fatigue.
